message: No detected input validation: No schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards are applied to the stock data fetched from Yahoo Finance or read from CSV before use.
No detected untrusted source handling: Data is fetched from Yahoo Finance via pandas_datareader without any checksum verification, authentication, or integrity checks on the returned data.

No detected label flipping detection: The code uses MinMaxScaler and splits data for LSTM training but performs no label distribution checks, validation against an expected label set, or label-noise detection tooling.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The data preparation pipeline reads the CSV and applies scaling directly with no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious samples before training.

No detected model integrity verification: The model path is fetched from a SQLite database and loaded directly via `keras.models.load_model(path)` with no hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision performed before or after loading.
No detected label distribution validation: The code performs no class balance check, expected-label-set validation, or anomaly detection on training samples before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse-style trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the training or inference code.
No detected differential privacy: The model is compiled and trained with standard Keras/Adam optimizer; no Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, or DP-SGD mechanisms are used.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: There is no use of adversarial testing libraries (e.g., Foolbox, ART) or any perturbation-based stress tests anywhere in the codebase.

No detected metric tampering protection: Although a train/test split is performed, the scaler is fit on training data and then applied to the full dataset including test data without strict isolation; there is only a single metric (R²), no hashing or signing of evaluation data, and no independent holdout verification.
No detected input sanitization: The inference path reads a CSV file and passes data directly to the model without any shape checks, range validation, schema enforcement, or malformed-input rejection.

No detected output bounds checks: The predicted price and r2 score are used directly after inverse_transform with only a rounding step; there are no NaN guards, negative-price checks, or sanity bounds on the output.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a numerical time-series LSTM model, not an LLM, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are implemented.
